preprocessing.audio: full retained source; Essentia MonoLoader mono 16000 Hz resampleQuality=4; no loudness normalization
preprocessing.pooling: float64 arithmetic mean of every returned patch sigmoid vector

distance: Jensen-Shannon divergence divided by ln(2), of (raw mean sigmoid + 1e-8) normalized to sum one
baseline: exact frozen Arm D cosine; C cosine sensitivity separately
grouping: transitive source/video/all credited artists; descending group size then sha256(style-prior-v1:+minimum track id); greedily smallest bucket, index tie-break
high_neighbor_slice: either endpoint in the other endpoint's exact D top 10 among all other frozen tracks; track ID breaks score ties

conditional_penalty.selection: maximum training anchor-macro strict ordinal preference accuracy; ties within 1e-12 choose smallest lambda; heldout tracks/artists excluded from both endpoints of training

limitations: all data are previously exposed development evidence
artist-fold uncertainty cannot be estimated credibly with only three folds
anchor bootstrap is descriptive because candidates recur across anchors
normalized multilabel sigmoid scores are not calibrated categorical probabilities
stop: No production activation; no new review queue until results identify a bounded question requiring human judgment. No alternate classifier or prompt search in v1.
